new_result.statement: For even m>=4, balanced signs, Y=m^-1/2 sum X_j, Z=m^-1/2 sum epsilon_j X_j, c_delta=sqrt(1+|delta|), Q=delta X_0^2+2 c_delta X_0 Y+Z^2, the nonzero spectrum has three absolute eigenvalues >=1 and ||p_Q||_infinity <= 3*2^(4/3)*(1+|delta|)^(-1/3) <=7.559526299369239 for arbitrary independent cap-one inputs. For |delta|<tau/2 and even m>(1+tau)/tau this family is inside strict N3(tau). Y,Z are a dependent same-bank product projection in general; Theorem MF retains original product provenance and does not assume projected independence.

obstructions: N3 does not force diffuse leverage: the hub leverage is exactly 1.
Every coordinate cross block has rank at most 2, so D'/D5 volume currencies vanish.
Every nonzero Pluecker triple contains the hub, so disjoint-Pluecker mass is zero.

For delta!=0, scalar Schur completion plus rank-two half-Riesz gives a valid certificate proportional to |delta|^(-1/4), which diverges at the null pivot while mixed Fresnel remains uniformly bounded.
next_implication: QFORM-N3-APPROXIMATE-SAME-BANK-HUB-ROUTING-v1: preserve actual original-coordinate factorization and route a leverage-heavy near-null hub to a quantitatively nondegenerate augmented Gram packet with a residual leaf direction, allowing overlap of the projected leaf directions, or to an already-paid branch. Do not replace this by receiver-side joint density or post-shear independence.
